book.name: Lum
book.title: Ŋwa wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Lum le

content: Muh gêe fiɛɛ fì joŋe muh wù le mbebe yo le
Besabɛŋ ba tɛɛme yi mbɛmɛ le kɛme ki be kâane shɛ́ŋ bɛ ŋgwe wù bamii ba wɛɛyi gwee. Keefɛ besabɛŋ gêe fiɛɛ nyume gɛh fì taŋlo ye joŋe gɛh nyume besabɛŋ gɛ.
Muh wu mumwaa wu mumwaa besabɛŋ le kɛme ki wu mône ki wu gêe fiɛɛ fì joŋe muh wù le mbebe ye le ki wu fî wu mbɛmɛ we kuu.
Bɛŋ kee tɛ lɛ gɛ Jiso Kletu kibɛɛ gɛ̀ gee mwɛɛ mù ye jôŋe gɛh nyume wu gɛ. Wu gɛ̀ gee fie fi kooshi no ba saŋ lɛ, muh jɛme Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: “Banchuŋ ba bamii naanyi wo yu, le bo tu ye yaŋ le.”

content: Besabɛŋ kee lɛ mwɛɛ munchii mù ba gɛ̀ saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le fweele gɛ̀ bee ki mu ntêfɛ besabɛŋ, wu lɛ mu ge besabɛŋ lɛ̂me bee tɛɛme, muntele mwesa besabɛŋ yûfe, besabɛŋ mo be jîiŋe fwe yi fiɛɛ fì bee lé be kɛ̂mɛ le.
Nlɛge lɛ Nyo wù gee bamii lɛme bo tɛɛme wu ka gee muntele mu bamii yufe, wu gê bɛŋ chêe yi fiɛɛ le fimimia bɛ bamii bachii bii no Kletu Jiso duunyi,
wu lɛ yi kintaashɛ le, bɛŋ tûme maŋkuŋ ma Nyo wù le Nyo mo Chiji Tada wese besabɛŋ wu Jiso Kletu yi jɛ le yimimia.
Bɛŋ fîi muh wuchii gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Kletu le wu fi bɛŋ
Bɛŋ mo bɛŋ fîi muh wuchii gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Kletu le wu fi bɛŋ, mbɛɛŋsɛ gɛɛne fɛ Nyo le.
Nsɛɛŋ bɛŋ le lɛ Kletu gɛ̀ be wu jo kikwɛɛ ke njɛ mwa lɛme fɛ Bajuu le ki wu dûnyɛ bo le lɛ Nyo to wu jɛmɛ nchiɛɛŋ. Wu gɛ̀ ge noo ki wu tôoŋ baŋka ba Nyo gɛ̀ nya bachiji chiji baboo le.
Wu gɛ̀ ge tɛ noo, wu lɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ̀ taŋlo bo bɛ̂ɛŋse tɛ Nyo nje yii yì Nyo kɛme fɛ bo le. Finɛ le no ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “No fi le noo, nlé ŋgê mbɛ̂ɛŋse wo
antɛnɛɛ a bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ.
Nlé ŋgê n'yɛ̂ɛnɛ mbɛ̂ɛŋse jee chuŋ.”

content: Fi ka nyume ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ, bɛŋ bɛ bamii ba Nyo lâŋeye.”

content: Fi ka nyume tɛ ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ, bɛŋ bɛ̂ɛŋse Tada.

content: Yosaya ka wu jɛmɛ tɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bia yimi lé yi gê yi sâaŋ a kfuu chi Jɛsi le,
nyume muh wù lé wu bû wu sâge bituŋ bi bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ.
Lé nyû yi ye ye le wù bituŋ lé bi gɛ̂ɛ bvufee bvuboo wu le.”

content: Nlɛge lɛ Nyo wu besabɛŋ jiiŋe fwe yi wu le, wu yisɛ muntele mwɛna bɛ njoŋ wuchii mo nyiɛgee no bɛŋ le bɛŋ leesɛ wa fitele yi ye ye le, wu lɛ a bvuŋga bvu Kiyo ki Yuude le, bɛŋ jiiŋe gɛh nyu fwe segechii yi fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ kee lɛ bɛŋ lé bɛŋ kɛ̂mɛ le.
Fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ fɛ Bol saŋ a je yì wu gɛ̀ saŋ le
Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, mɛ kibɛɛ ŋkee chuule lɛ bɛŋ kɛme kiŋge ki joŋe baaŋ, bɛŋ yisɛ bɛ bvufee, bɛŋ kee tɛ ki bɛŋ têefe bikwɛɛ biɛna.
Geenɛ, yi mwɛɛ mumu le, nle nsaŋ nchoojɛ lo bɛŋ le. Ŋgee noo ki ntaŋ bɛŋ, nje nfii wù Nyo nya mɛne,

lɛ mɛ nyûme muh wu lɛme wu Kletu Jiso fɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ. Ŋgee lɛme chinɛ njɛ chiji kintanyɛ, nlɛne yi saaka wù joŋe wù wu Nyo le, wu lɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ nyûme njɛ kintanyɛ ki Nyo le wu bɛɛŋ, Kiyo ki Yuude seesɛ bo ki gɛɛ yeye.
Noo, taŋlo nchiaase ye yi lɛme chaŋ chì nlɛne Nyo le, nje nle ntaashɛ besa Kletu Jiso.

Gɛ taŋlo mɛ moŋ lo njɛ̂mɛ kune fiɛɛ fimi yeye gɛ, fede fì Kletu le wu ge wa fede yi ye yaŋ le, lɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ, leese fitele yi Nyo le. Bo gɛ̀ leese fitele bo bii mwɛɛ mù ŋgɛ̀ njɛme le bɛ mù ŋgɛ̀ ŋgee le.

Gɛ̀ bee tɛ fì bii yi bvuŋga bvu mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo le, bɛ mwɛɛ mu jwe wu yunɛ mù ŋgɛ̀ ŋgee le, fede yi bvuŋga bvu Kiyo ki Yuude le. Noo, kɛge Yɛlusalɛm ki kɛnɛ gɛɛŋ bu kimbe kì Ililikuŋ le, nyu nlɛɛŋ wa chuule ki nfejɛ saaka wù joŋe kune Kletu yo.
Ŋgɛ gee noo, a ntaŋ waŋ wù baaŋ le lɛ nfêeji saaka wù joŋe wunɛ nyume fɛ ba gɛ̀ baaŋ a yu gɛ wa kune Kletu gɛ, wu lɛ keefɛ ŋge nja ŋgɛɛŋ njoone yi kinfu ki muh mu le gɛ.
Ŋgɛ̀ gee finɛ fiɛɛ mbii gɛh nyume no ba gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Bamii ba bo gɛ̀ baaŋ a sɛɛŋ gɛ̀ wa bo le kune wu gɛ,
bo lé bo yɛ̂ŋ nchiɛɛŋ we le,
bamii ba gɛ̀ baaŋ a yu gɛ wa kune wu gɛ, lé bo gê bo kɛ̂ɛ wu.”

content: No Bol gɛ̀ seese ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ Lum
Chi jeese ba jiɛnyɛ banɛ mɛ kiŋgane ki duude le fɛ nto besabɛŋ yɛnɛ.
Geenɛ, mɛɛse gɛ kijusɛ ki lɛme ka baaŋ yu bimbe binɛ le gɛ. Noo no nche nshee ŋgoone wa biluŋ le ki nto lɛ besabɛŋ yɛnɛ,
le ŋkwaji, ŋkee lɛ besabɛŋ lé be gê be yɛ̂nɛ sege nfede ŋgɛɛne Sbɛŋ. Ŋkwaji tɛ lɛ bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ fîh mɛ yi jiɛnyɛ waŋ le ki ŋgɛ̂ɛŋ mbu yo, sege besabɛŋ moji shige, n'yu njoŋ a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ.
Geenɛ, mɛɛse nle ŋgɛɛŋ Yɛlusalɛm yi lɛme le fɛ bamii ba le ba Nyo ba yo le.
Ŋgɛɛne yo nje bamii ba mbɛmɛ ba Masɛdonia mo ba Akɛya bo koŋe ki bo fɛ kinsu ki bo fi bamii ba le ba Nyo ba fuude yu Yɛlusalɛm.

Gɛ̀ koŋ bo ki bo ge noo, le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ bo gɛ̀ kɛme ki bo ge fiɛɛ fɛ bo le noo, nje nɛ baa bò le gɛ̀ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ le bo kɛmɛ wa mbuu wu fii biyo biboo wu le wu Bajuu, tu bo kɛme tɛ ki bo fîh Bajuu bɛ mwɛɛ mu yi nshɛŋ le fɛnɛ mù Nyo le wu buu bo yu.
Noo, sege nlé mɛ̂sɛ lɛme chinɛ, n'yɛŋ lɛ fiɛɛ fì bo su le fi lee chiaaŋ yi Bajuu le, mɛ mo nja yo, nfe yaa a bɛŋ le, besabɛŋ yɛnɛ, mɛ mo ŋgɛ̂ɛŋ Sbɛŋ.
Ŋkee lo lɛ sege ŋge ndoo ntoo a bɛŋ le, ntoo bɛ kimbonɛ ki Kletu fɛ bɛŋ le a ki yisɛ.
Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, ŋkude lo chiaaŋ bɛŋ le a jee chi Tada wese besabɛŋ wù Jiso Kletu le mo yi kiŋkoŋɛ ki Kiyo ki Yuude le, lɛ bɛŋ tâashɛ bɛ mɛ besabɛŋ bûune Nyo chuule fɛ mɛne,
lɛ taŋlo ŋge mbu chiaaŋ yi bamii ba le gɛ ba mbɛmɛ le gɛ ba Judia. Besabɛŋ bûune tɛ lɛ bamii ba le gɛ ba Nyo gɛ bɛɛŋ lɛme chì ŋgɛɛne ki ŋge Yɛlusalɛm,
wu lɛ Nyo nɛ le wu bɛɛŋ, ŋge ndoo ntoo a bɛŋ le n'yûge njoŋ, fitele fiaŋ jiɛɛ lo a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ.
Nyo wù le Nyo wu nyiɛgee nyûme bena bo bachii. Fi nyûme noo.
